scope: Read-only source/manifest audit plus a small no-model conformer control; no folding or pose-accuracy result.
endToEndWorkflowDifferences: Molarium canonicalizes SMILES through RDKit before LocalFold parses them.
Molarium passes the requested model seed to smilesComponent; stock foldAf3 omits that option and derives the conformer seed from the SMILES hash.
Molarium controls alignment provisioning, explicit step/recycle/seed settings, progress/cancellation and result export.
verdict: Unmodified pinned engine modules and matching manifests; no claim of upstream-page end-to-end equivalence.
